By way of the present petition, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR bearing No. 199/2023,
registered at Police Station Gandhi Nagar, Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 366A/376(2)(N)(3) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC') and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (hereafter POCSO Act).
2. Issue notice.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012

sentences.text: The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.

3. Issue notice to the prosecutrix through the concerned Investigating Officer (I.O.) for the next date of hearing.
4.

5. Let the Trial Court Record, in digitized form, be called for, at least two days prior to the next date of hearing.
